title: iAM Capital Is Founded
points: iAM Capital is founded by Privatbank Bellerive AG

title: iAM Capital Builds A New Strategy
points: iAM Capital adapts its strategy to post financial crisis environment to create a more nimble platform

title: Continuation of corporate restructuring and strategic investments into alternative strategies
points: iAM Capital completes a strategic investment and syndication in Marex Spectron Group Limited, a leading global commodities brokerage

title: Finalization of corporate restructuring and launch of alternatives fund management
points: iAM Capital forms a Luxembourg investment vehicle with Integrated Alternative Opportunities Fund (“IAO”) as a sub-fund
iAM Capital sells its FCA regulated UK and Italian brokerage businesses to US securities trading platform and Central European Investment bank to focus on its core business

title: Launch and first close of Integrated Real Estate Opportunities Fund (“IREO”) and Integrated Green Opportunities Fund (“IGO”)
points: iAM Capital launches its first dedicated real estate fund, IREO
iAM Capital initiates institutional renewable energy investments through IGO

title: Final close of IREO and continued investments into alternatives
points: iAM Capital becomes one of the sponsors of FinTLV Ventures L.P., a fintech venture fund with a focus on InsureTech companies based in Israel
iAM Capital invests in Heritage Family Office Ltd in a strategic marketing partnership

title: Sale of solar portfolio and new-economy hospitality investment
points: iAM Capital invests into Sweet Inn Luxembourg, the holding company of a fast growing short-term rental group, through its alternatives fund, IAO
iAM Capital successfully sells its majority interest in the Econergy Solar PV Portfolio to EF Solare Italia, Italy’s largest owner of solar energy plants

title: Full deployment of IREO and first close of iAM Capital Europe II Fund (“ICE II”)
points: iAM Capital holds first close of its second dedicated real estate fund, ICE II
IREO final deployment comprised of eleven transactions between Italy and France, investing in c. 24,500 sqm of assets.

title: Acquisition of 22,500 sqm portfolio in Milan and Rome, and continuation of the solar strategy
points: iAM Capital acquires a portfolio of 5 solar plants in Italy with a 4.5MWp capacity
ICE II completes the  acquisition of a premier real estate portfolio comprising four assets  of c. 22,500 sqm in Rome and Milan

title: Acquisition of trophy asset in Rome for ICE II and further solar investments
points: ICE II completed the trophy asset acquisition of Palazzo Sanzio, in Rome; an office asset to be converted into a 5-star luxury hospitality asset

title: Launch of the third real estate fund
points: Launch of ICE III fund investing in Southern Europe with a 15% IRR target; strong reup from ICE II investors.
ICE II completed the acquisition of Capo mimosa, a 55,000 sqm beachfront land in Cervo, Italy to develop hospitality.

title: Acquisitions in Italy
points: Acquisition of two strong NPLs backed by exceptional assets in Italy.

title: Selective acquisitions in Southern Europe
points: Acquisition of three hospitality assets in Spain and one in Italy by the ICE III fund, further strengthening its presence in key Southern European tourism markets.
